rv.q: Still, even a Company with flaws is still well worth an audience’s time in the theatre.
Graham Todd as Bobby brings the requisite boyish charm and excellent vocal capability to the role.
Not only does he observe their personality quirks and incompatibilities, but also their contempt for each other or their smothering each other with too much affection.

cn.t: This half-century-old Sondheim musical receives mixed-to-positive reviews, with critics finding it more hit than miss. The production delivers an enjoyable, entertaining experience with a distinct mid-century vibe, though execution varies.
